_why: #1082: the bold phrases in tutorials/*.md that are NOT words on a button, so the suite's 'every button a lesson names exists in the app' check skips them. Each says what it is instead. Lower case, quotes and ellipses plain.
add 2 effects: 03: the count in the button is live (Add N effects)
ctrl+shift+z: 10: a key combination, not a label
cue 1 / 2: 12: the counter is live (Cue N / M)
share \"your project name\" live: 17: the lesson's stand-in for his project's name
editing \"name\": 18: the lesson's stand-in for the template's name
apply ... and switch: Simple 01: the button names the size he picked (Apply 9:16 and switch)
skip-to-start: Simple 04: describes the icon beside the time counter
1.5×: Simple 09: a value on the speed row, live
share \"project 1\" live: Simple 12: the card names the project (Share “Project 1” live)
